title: JATT II Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: JATT II Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands-based SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing completion of its IPO of 6,000,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 per share on April 20, 2026, generating $60,000,000 in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, the company completed a private placement of 300,000 shares to JATT Ventures II L.P. for $3,000,000. Total net proceeds of $60,000,000 were deposited in a trust account.
key_points: JATT II Acquisition Corp completed IPO of 6,000,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 per share on April 20, 2026
Gross IPO proceeds totaled $60,000,000 with $1,800,000 underwriters' deferred fee
Private placement of 300,000 shares to JATT Ventures II L.P. raised an additional $3,000,000
Total of $60,000,000 deposited in trust account for benefit of public shareholders
Underwriters have 45-day over-allotment option for up to 900,000 additional shares at $10.00
Company is an emerging growth company incorporated in the Cayman Islands
